verdict.rationale: Perplexity's own Agent API lets a user hand off tasks to a Perplexity-hosted agent: a `preset` gives "a working agent in one field", and Perplexity runs built-in tools for it (web search, URL fetch, a code sandbox). Through the Computer MCP server, users can also delegate multi-step work such as browsing, running code, and creating documents. However, there is no evidence of an assistant embedded in the product's own interface (console or dashboard) that users can talk to there; delegation happens through API calls or external MCP clients. Missing for 10: an in-product UI assistant for delegating tasks, any independent or hands-on corroboration of task delegation.
